page.layout: One page with two parallel columns of a Scripture index (Cap. | Vers. | Pag.), headed INDEX; the left column holds Matthew and the right column Mark and Luke under their headings. No running head, no page number, no notes in the margins. A digitiser's watermark at the lower right is ignored.

main_text.head: INDEX.
main_text.l: Cap. | Vers. | Pag. | Cap. | Vers. | Pag.
main_text.head: MATTHÆUS
MARCUS
LUCAS

page.notes: The index is set in two parallel columns; the table is transcribed as rows with cells separated by " | ", the left column read first, then the right. Blue underlined figures are printed in colour/underlined in the original and are copied as numbers. Several entries are hard to read on the scan (the spacing of the Matthew and Luke cells and the figures in the lower right corner) and are copied as they appear, without certainty. The headings MATTHÆUS, MARCUS and LUCAS are set in spaced capitals in the scan; their exact spelling is inferred from the set-out letters (M A T T H, M A R C U S, L U C A S). The bottom "Cap." is the start of a catchword-like line and is given as a list line.
